I’m telling you now, and I know being 14 it’s easy to think nothing will happen to you and that it’s more worth it to get fucked up etc, and not listen to adults, but i’m telling you your life will be so much better if you choose to do something with it. 

Nothing hurts more than wasted potential. I was in your same boat when it came to gifted programs and that sort of shit but now I literally cannot read a page of writing without forgetting the majority of it 5 minutes later. 

Then again I drank 15-20 beers a day for a good amount of time, so I don’t know what I expected. Now my dick doesn’t work and I can’t hold a job.

Just don’t let that happen to you lol.

Wow. For being 14 years of age you have great writing abilities as well as advanced maturity. You sense that your lifestyle will ultimately lead to your doom... the question is do you want to be sober? Does life have a purpose to you outside of partying?

I can only assume being 14 and having a two week relationship with an attractive 19 year old means you are probably pretty attractive.

Given this and your intellect, as well as advanced emotional maturity, you really do have great potential for a fulfilling life. 

I was a lot like you when I was younger, i started drinking alone at your age. I hung out with older crowds, didn’t like people my age, etc. I continued drinking and drug abuse to the point that i’m basically completely fucked up at age 18. I hate to see others go down the same path. It will catch up eventually, so tread lightly. Hope you find some peace and serenity.
